main_text.p: cipem ex Ethnico Chriftianum, quæ Chriftiani ad Principem è Christiano Ethnicum factum : quem tamen vel Ethnicorum adversus Constantinum Gentilismo renunciantem, sacris Chri-stianorum mysterijs initiatum, quem inquam, vel senatorem, vel Militem, vel civem levissimam seditionem religio-nis causa movisse constat ? Erubescant igitur hic Christiani, & ab Infidelibus Christianam tandem, & ipsi discant o-bedientiam.

Sed quid interim in Oriente factum? ibi furor Licinii in Ecclesias insultare graffariqué coepit, quem constat quam plures Christianos militia nobiles, ignominiæ causa ad opus publicum dam-nasse; alios insuper ad textrinam, alia-que opera gynnecæa ascripsisse, id quod testatur ipsemet {z}ConstantinusLib.2.de vita Constantini Cap.25. in edicto quod primum post expugnatum Lici-nium pro Christianis edidit.Huius insu-per persecutionis sub Licinio meminit Basilius in oratione in 40.Martyres; ubi confitentibus omnium poenarum genera, ignem, ensem, botrum, culeum, rotam, flagellum proposita[?] et ex eorum con-

page.notes: The facing page's edge (left of the scan) is not transcribed. "propositaj" is uncertain: the final glyph may be a semicolon. "graffariqué" is an unusual form; the accent is as printed. "perfecutionis", "myfterijs" and "gynnecæa" are kept as printed. The paragraph ends mid-word at "con-"; the next page continues it.
